name: Swift

requires.installHint: Install Xcode 16 or newer, or a Swift 6 toolchain from https://swift.org/install.

ide: Run `open Package.swift` to open it in Xcode.
runnerHint: Install Xcode 16 or newer, or a Swift 6 toolchain from https://swift.org/install.

levelHints.Beginner: new to Swift: optionals, structs vs classes, collections.
levelHints.Intermediate: comfortable day to day: protocols and extensions, enums with associated values, error handling, closures.
levelHints.Advanced: design trade-offs: generics and associated types, async/await, actors, ARC and capture lists.
levelHints.Expert: deep language and runtime topics: Sendable and strict concurrency, copy-on-write types, result builders, performance.
